description: x402-hyperliquid-book: Hyperliquid L2 order book for one perpetual, with derived microstructure a trading agent actually uses — best bid/ask, spread in ticks and basis points, midpoint, and bid/ask depth imbalance over the requested levels. Thin books and lopsided depth are how you spot a bad fill before you send it.
